scope.summary: Font sources: Studio resolves fonts from OS-installed fonts and from a Studio-managed local font library; there is NO required cloud font service ([STU-OVR-002]); an org-shared/project-embedded font set MAY be supported as a local library, not a subscription dependency (Figma font sources, de-clouded). Font picker: MUST preview each family in its own glyphs, search by name, filter by source/classification, and support favorites and similar-font filtering (PS/Figma font pickers, deduped). Operator picker + model command.
acceptance_criteria: OS + local-library font sources, no cloud dep; picker with glyph preview/search/filter/favorites/similar
proof_targets: OS+local font resolution + picker preview/filter test
expected_tests: live: fonts resolve from OS + local library; no cloud service dependency
argus: picker previews family in own glyphs, search/filter by source/classification, favorites + similar-font filter

risk_if_missed: No font resolution/picker; type unusable; cloud-dependency risk.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
